purpose: Manual and regression demo corpus for URL, message and QR intake. Categories are intended test labels, not guaranteed predictions from the current model.
safety: Suspicious and dangerous URLs use reserved .example or .invalid domains and are non-routable. Genuine examples use well-known public sites; scanning them may contact configured DNS/redirect providers.

samples.message: The Python documentation site is available here: https://www.python.org/
samples.rationale: Official Python project website; no urgency or credential request.

samples.message: You can read the article on Wikipedia: https://www.wikipedia.org/
samples.rationale: Known public reference site; neutral message.

samples.message: URGENT: Your bank access will be suspended. Verify your password now: http://secure-bank-login-verify.invalid/urgent/account/confirm
samples.rationale: Impersonation-style wording, urgency, password request, and a synthetic non-routable domain.

samples.message: Your refund is waiting. Enter your UPI PIN to receive money: http://upi-refund-claim.invalid/collect/upi-pin
samples.rationale: Requests a UPI PIN to receive a refund; users should never share a UPI PIN.

samples.message: Payroll account locked. Send your password to restore access: http://payroll-password-reset.invalid/employee/login
samples.rationale: Credential disclosure request and pressure to restore account access.

samples.message: Final warning: pay this fee immediately or your parcel will be destroyed: http://parcel-fee-pay-now.invalid/customs/settle
samples.rationale: High-pressure payment demand on a synthetic non-routable domain.
